robot_native: Cloud Ginger 云端机器人小姜
target_applications: reception, education, healthcare/eldercare, exhibition guiding, teleoperated service

dof_per_arm.source: arm+hand joint distribution not itemized publicly

torso_lift.value: fixed torso with waist and knee SCA joints (crouch/bow motion)

actuators.value: 34x SCA Smart Compliant Actuators (in-house integrated torque-controlled joints; commercialized via INNFOS/Mintasca)

end_effector.value: five-finger hands with SCA-driven fingers (gesture + light grasping)

sensors_wrist_hand.value: joint torque sensing in all SCAs

sensors_base.value: lidar, ultrasonic, IMU; SLAM/VSLAM; 30mm step, ±15° slope

compute.value: onboard processors + HARIX cloud brain over 4G/5G (cloud-dependent)

software_stack.value: HARIX OS (海睿) cloud AI: multimodal deep learning, NLP dialogue, visual grasping, multi-robot scheduling, human teleop fallback; closed source

safety_compliance.value: compliant actuation marketed as human-safe; no public certifications

availability.value: effectively unavailable; company at standstill since 09/2024

deployment_evidence.value: COVID field hospitals (Wuhan/Shanghai), telecom stores, schools, exhibitions 2019-2023; volumes undisclosed

notes: Company collapse: wage arrears from 01/2024, standstill from 09/2024, ¥35.3M court-ordered debts by 03/2025; 2025 rescue attempts (Tianjin Jinnan state agreement, HK 'Boy Robotics' JV with Guohua Group) not visibly productive. Status set to discontinued (de facto) though vendor site still lists product.
